family_note: NC+PBRS control for the 2026-07-15 single-edge sweep. New reward family vs plain NC (reward_version differs); cache-hit MICRO is read from env hit-tracking and stays comparable with the shipped WC/NC columns. WC seed 7 is re-run only as a reproduction check of the shipped WC column.

code_snapshot.note: definition cells identical to done.ipynb.bak-perf-20260714-171214 except DQNAgent_NC (= NC + PBRS learn); verified 2026-09-16

environment_version: done.ipynb single-edge (unified Environment, tuple mode), persistent cache
action_space_version: NCPBRS: M rec-only + popularity caching heuristic; WC: M x (K+1) joint

reward_version.NCPBRS: nc_pbrs_v1: hit=1/miss=0 + PBRS Phi (secured + (1-secured)*fallback) scaled 0.1, identical to DQNAgent_WC.learn; applied inside learn(), env reward unshaped
reward_version.WC: hit=1/miss=0 + PBRS Phi scaled 0.1 (as shipped sweep)

optimizer_config: AdamW; sigma group lr=5e-5 wd=0; rest lr=1e-4 wd=1e-3; grad clip 5.0
checkpoint_selection_metric: 200-episode rolling mean of per-episode cache-hit rate (train), best_state_dict loaded before eval -- same as shipped sweep
baseline_reference: paired against shipped seed_sweep_NC_NO_PBRS\seed_sweep_results.csv (WC_micro, NC_micro; same seeds, same env realisation, same eval episodes)

cache_hit_MICRO.definition: total hits / total steps, pooled over eval episodes

seeding_protocol: set_seed(seed) + fresh Environment before train and before eval (notebook _run_rl_agent)
execution: one (agent, seed) per OS process, N processes concurrently on one GPU
